ranges.exhaustive_direct_b2: n=2,3, one or two colors, every support of size at most n and every listed power assignment with exactly two inconsistent centered singletons
ranges.exhaustive_selected_supports: n=2,3 with one or two colors and n=4 with one color, every support, every pair of inconsistent cells, every subset of good centered cells and every selected subset of the other cells
ranges.sampled_exact: 4<=n<=10, one to three colors, 120 fixed-seed patterns for each pair, b=2 and a separate b>=2 assignment

methods.small: Direct enumeration of all uniform permutations independently in each color
methods.sampled: Exact expansion into compatible indicator subsets
methods.attainment: Independent binomial expansion of all good centered factors and the mutually exclusive retained pair

limitations: The sampled tests are not exhaustive over their parameter ranges
